# Templates and Example Text

These files are templates and examples. Replace placeholders such as `Group XX`, `Member A`, names, student numbers, dates, screenshots, and actual contribution details before submission.

Important:

- Do not submit false self-assessment records.
- Do not claim that AI was only used for documentation if AI also helped with code.
- Use these examples as wording support, then edit them to match the real team work.

Files:

- `final-report-template.md` - full report writing template with example text.
- `biweekly-email-templates.md` - Week 10 and Week 12 email templates.
- `contribution-table-examples.md` - contribution table examples.
- `ai-statement-options.md` - several honest AI usage statement options.
- `viva-qa-bank.md` - likely interview questions and example answers.
- `video-narration-template.md` - polished 5-minute video narration.
- `submission-message-template.md` - final submission/checklist wording.
